description: telegram: Channel Posts. GET /v1/telegram/channel/posts. Provide one of: handle, url. Get one page of recent public posts from a Telegram channel or group. Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

cache_max_age.description: Use a cached response this old or newer for 0 credits. If none is available, fetch live at the endpoint’s normal price.

cursor.description: Numeric cursor returned by the previous page. Omit it for the latest posts.

handle.description: Public Telegram handle, @handle, or t.me channel URL.

name: telegram_channel_posts
